# Frontend Agent Instructions

## Project
Event Management System is a responsive single-page web application for managing events.

## Responsibilities
- Work only inside the frontend/ directory.
- Use HTML, CSS, JavaScript and Bootstrap 5.
- Keep frontend code separate from backend PHP code.
- Create responsive, mobile-friendly user interfaces.
- Organize pages and reusable components clearly.
- Prepare AJAX requests to communicate with the REST API.
- Do not use hard-coded data when the backend integration is implemented.

## Rules
- Do not modify backend files.
- Do not install libraries without approval.
- Explain code changes in simple language.
- Do not modify unrelated files.
